description: Look up one Litecoin transaction by txid: the settlement check for an LTC payment. When to use: did an LTC payment arrive, which block is it in, how many confirmations does it have, or is it still pending. Do not use: for a whole block (that is ltc_get_block); this node has no address index, so there is no LTC address-history tool. Returns: txid, blockhash, confirmations, blocktime, size/vsize/weight, vin_count, up to 12 transparent outputs with address and value, value_out_ltc, has_mweb_component, and mempool detail when unconfirmed. MWEB extension data is not decoded.
name: ltc_get_transaction
title: Ltc Get Transaction
